items.title: Apache Tomcat Security Vulnerabilities Expose Servers to Remote Code Execution Attacks
items.description: The Apache Software Foundation has highlighted critical flaws in Apache Tomcat, a widely used open-source Java servlet container that powers numerous web applications. On October 27, 2025, Apache disclosed two vulnerabilities, CVE-2025-55752 and CVE-2025-55754, affecting multiple versions of Tomcat.
